description: This file provides utility functions for handling environment variables, file system operations, and error descriptions. It includes functions for verifying data types, parsing environment variable values, normalizing numbers, manipulating file paths, performing secure file writes, and describing errors. The code is aimed at facilitating safe and structured file I/O and environment handling in a Node.js/TypeScript project.
